correctness.rationale: A rank-s idempotent is a projection onto an s-plane W along a complement L, of which there are q^{s(n−s)} for each W. Fix E with image U and kernel T. EF=0 requires W within T. FE=0 requires U within L; counting (n−r−s)-planes L/U in V/U gives the same Gaussian coefficient, and again q^{s(n−s)} complements. Their intersection consists exactly of projections that are zero on U and restrict to rank-s idempotents on T, yielding the subtraction term. Neither direction is possible if s>n−r. Self-adjacency does not occur because E²=E≠0. For nested coordinate projections, every neighbor of E_r is also a neighbor of E_(r−1); the projection onto ker(E_(r−1)) along im(E_(r−1)) has rank n−r+1 and witnesses strict inclusion (it is a vertex for 2≤r≤n−1 and cannot neighbor E_r by the rank constraint). The only minimum-degree rank is n−1, also when n=2 where there is only one rank. Substituting r=n−1 gives δ=2q^{n−1}−1 and M=q^{n−1}(1+q+⋯+q^{n−1}). Therefore Q=(δ+1)/2 and A=M/Q satisfy q(A−Q)=A−1 with A−Q>0. This uniquely determines q and then n, and isomorphic fields give the converse graph isomorphism. The example parameters and the frozen log's case count agree with the displayed formulas. The uploaded checker was inspected, not rerun; no computation is needed for the universal proof.
residual_risks: The proof uses full matrix rings over finite fields, n≥2, excluding zero and identity, with OR rather than mutual-annihilation adjacency. The 699372 logged ordered pairs are finite support only.

originality.rationale: At the level of the claim, the distinct contribution supported by the evidence is all-rank OR-degree stratification, strict rank separation in higher dimensions, and reconstruction of the full finite matrix ring from two unlabeled degree statistics for n≥2. The rank multiplicities, the one-direction zero-product counts, and the dimension-two OR graph degree are credited as existing pieces, not novel results. No inspected statement recovers the higher-dimensional OR degree multiset or its reconstruction conclusion.
residual_risks: The unidentified directed-triangle count has not been verified and the older AND paper's full text was unavailable. Neither is used as negative evidence or as a premise for correctness. Obscure exact higher-dimensional OR graph work outside the inspected sources remains possible.

value.rationale: The graph is a natural invariant built from one-sided vanishing of products, and the theorem recovers the algebraic rank of every vertex and the entire ring isomorphism type from graph degrees. Recovering the two ring parameters from just the smallest degree and its multiplicity, without labels or the full adjacency matrix, makes the invariant useful beyond a finite count or a restatement of the two-dimensional result.
residual_risks: There is no asserted reconstruction across arbitrary finite rings, or from minimum degree alone when dimension is not given.
